title: Contracting, a Public Service Mission
subtitle: Dr. Cherkaoui & Dr. Berrada are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🏥

Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada are two dentists driven by the same passion: caring for patients. But one practices in the public sector, the other in the private sector.

Faced with the shortage of dentists in rural areas, Decree No. 2.12.507 offers a solution: contracting.

Between calls for applications, 4-hour sessions, 286 DH per session, professional obligations, and terminations... the path is full of obstacles.

Access to care for underprivileged populations, their health, their future rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada discover the basics of contracting: conditions, remuneration, professional obligations, and termination. The public service mission begins.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada deepen their knowledge of the ONMD, the fight against illegal practice, patient protection, and dental demography in Morocco.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada face complex situations: advanced contracting procedures, administrative management, legal aspects. They must master the intricacies of the system.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada dive into public health issues: fight against illegal practice, patient protection, ethics, and the role of the ONMD.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada become references in public health. They train young dentists on the importance of contracting and access to care for all.
chapters.expert2: After years of public service and commitment, Dr. Cherkaoui and Dr. Berrada pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of skills in public health and social equity to the dental profession.
